title: Wejście do piramidy
description: Boczny plan wejścia. Van z już zapaloną pochodnią odsuwa pnącza i znika w ciemnym portalu; kamera pozostaje na zewnątrz. Jedna prosta czynność, bez zmiany kąta.

prompts.image: Cinematic live-action landscape 16:9. Side-on medium-wide shot at the overgrown pyramid entrance. Van Sabe, matching the character references exactly, holds an already lit torch and begins parting wet vines before entering the black stone portal. Warm torchlight against cool humid jungle, clear spatial geography, grounded adventure-noir, no other people, no text.
prompts.animation: One continuous 2-second shot. Static camera outside the pyramid entrance. Van parts the wet vines with one hand, takes one cautious step forward and disappears into the black portal while the torch flame and nearby leaves move naturally. Preserve exact identity, anatomy, wardrobe, satchel, jungle and architecture. No new people, morphing, extra limbs, cuts, captions, logos or watermark.
